main_text.p: unumquodque, poculum exhauritur, & ita convivium claudโitur. Plura vid. Maffec.Berac. c.8.1. & in toto hoc Maymon. tract.

Consessus nobiliores fuerunt in Lydda sub R. Eleasare; sub Rabban Iochanan Ben Saccai in לבוד חיל. In פיעין sub R. Iofua. In Iabhne sub R. Gamaliele; in Bene Barak sub R. Akiba. Romæ, præfide R. Mathia. In Sicni Rectore R. Chananía Ben Teradion. In Zippo-rin Rectore R. Iofe. In Nisibin, Rectore Iudah Ben Bethira. In Pompeditha RectoreR. Iosua; in Beth Schaarim, Rectore Rabbi. Bab. Sanhedrin fol. 32. 2. Quæ omnia quidem בית דין vocantur, sed in quibusdam ex illis locis simplices Scholæ fuerunt, non autem tales Senatus qualis Majestuosus ille in conclavi Gazit, qui ut præstantissimus his appenditur coronidis loco. vid. Synedria.

Contractuum instrumentis inscribebatur à iudicibus ad eorum confirmationem, שטרות &c. Contractus prodiit in confpectum nostrum testificantibus N. & N. de subsignatione manuum suarum; unde confirmamus & stabilimus eum. Metzia 7. 2. vid. Cl. Castellum in pp.

Coriarius. Talis fuit Iudas Ifcariot; vid. f. 1. Væ illi cuius opificium coriarium est. Kiddufchin fol.82.2. Et proinde ex Coriariis nullus poterat Rex fieri; Maymon. Hal. Melachim c.1. & Kiddufchin 1. m. c. Cadavera, sepulchra, officinas coriariorum, quinquaginta cubitos ab urbe removent, neque illam collocant nisi versus orientem urbis. Bava Batra

page.notes: Scan is of a left-hand page of a book (page 832 with a catchword "Batra"); the right half is cropped. Several Hebrew words are inline and transcribed approximately. Marginal stains at left edge are not text. Line "claudḯtur" partly obscured; the marked character is uncertain.
